learning_question: Across live ∪ admitted markets, do observe-only selective ~3m plain-EY + momentum entries (market-native, no FX), sized as a fixed-stake mechanical test, beat a patient plain-value hold on the same eligible set after fair local costs?

patient_hold_baseline.definition: Same universe and market-native returns; plain EY top-30% local; no momentum filter; same financial_health pass; same 63 trading-day or identity/quality-break exit; same fixed 100 local-currency stake; fair per-market costs. Excess vs strategy is report-only.

soft_gaps: Entry fields: observe refresh enriches EY from key_metrics P/E / trailing_pe / earnings_yield_* and financial_health from passed_models/failed_models (archive + library panels). 12–1 mom uses calendar lookback on snapshot prices, then optional daily price fetch (cap per refresh). Still fail-closed when fields/bars remain missing (F8).

Admitted-market weekly panels: walker loads library signals_*.csv + models_*.json.gz for ladder.admitted_learning_markets when present; residual markets without screen panels are listed on the observe store (panel_coverage).
Hold of 63 trading days uses session dates from fetched/panel price bars when available, else numpy busday with a small per-market holiday table (weekday fallback only if that fails).
